Native-safe browser-only behaviour (contract rules 4,5,7): (a) ErrorDisplay's react-router-dom navigation + window.location.href='/login' are structurally unavailable on native (no in-app router, no DOM window.location) -> best-effort Linking.openURL, with unresolvable web routes swallowed so a failed nav never crashes the card. (b) @/hooks/useOnlineStatus has no navigator.onLine / online-offline events on native -> a mount snapshot of the api client's last getConnectionStatus(); live connectivity transitions are not observable and the manual Retry control is the recovery path. (c) The web ConfirmDialog's window keydown Escape->cancel maps to RN Modal onRequestClose (Android hardware back) + backdrop press; its unused-here features (silenceKey/localStorage, requireTypedConfirmation, loading spinner) are deliberately omitted because this caller never passes them.
